header.window: posts from 2025-10-28 to 2026-10-21: the last 365 days, leaving out the 7 days before the run
header.audience: Owners and front-desk managers of small salons, clinics and studios who lose money to no-shows and phone tag, and want a calendar that fills itself (inferred from the top posts and their topics; an inference, not a measurement)

networks.why: The x-organic accounts lookup found no X account for this business, so there was no X history to read, and the user didn't ask for X drafts.

what_the_history_says.scoring: views divided by the median views of the same network's posts in the same calendar month; 1.0 is an ordinary post

highest_scored_posts.first_line: How long does your front desk spend on the phone?
2 lines that make a no-show policy stick
How did a two-chair salon fill its Tuesday gaps?
Do your clients forget their appointments?
What does one empty chair cost you each week?

lowest_scored_posts.first_line: New: reminder texts in your clients' language
Our booking page got a faster checkout this week
Now you can take deposits when clients book

strategy.audience_and_action: Owners and front-desk managers of small salons, clinics and studios who lose money to no-shows and phone tag, and want a calendar that fills itself (inferred from the top posts and their topics; an inference, not a measurement); every post leads to one action: visit the site.

network_roles.Instagram: Lead: highest median views per post in the last 90 days (2003)
network_roles.TikTok: Support: gets the lead's pieces adapted (1285 median views)
network_roles.Facebook Page: Support: gets the lead's pieces adapted (278 median views)

strategy.mix_math: weights 3, 2, 3, 1, 1 of 10; each share rounded to the nearest 5; difference of 0 to No-show fixes; Product news stays at 10%, within the 20% cap for promotion

cadence.source: the team's capacity from the request (4 new pieces a week)

strategy.gaps: Instagram had 1 gap of 14 days or more in the last 180 days, the longest 23 days; TikTok had 1 gap of 14 days or more in the last 180 days, the longest 27 days; Facebook Page had 1 gap of 14 days or more in the last 180 days, the longest 25 days. All of them are the August break; batch the weeks before a break so the accounts keep posting.

posting_days.rule: post on better days first, never on worse days while another day is free

strategy.formats: Video: no difference shown (1.0, 48 posts); Reel: better (1.34, 40 posts); Photo: worse (0.58, 31 posts); Carousel: no difference shown (1.09, 18 posts); Link: no difference shown (1.0, 9 posts); Text: too few to judge (3.36, 1 post). Do more Reels; rework photos as carousels; test a Facebook text post.
strategy.hooks: statement: no difference shown (0.91, 49 posts); question: better (1.36, 42 posts); number: no difference shown (1.07, 41 posts); announcement: worse (0.5, 15 posts). Open with a question on the better days; give product news a statement or a question instead of 'New:'.

hashtags.verdicts: 1 to 5: better (1.28, 78 posts); none: no difference shown (0.86, 37 posts); 6 or more: worse (0.58, 32 posts)
hashtags.rule: Instagram and TikTok: #examplebooking plus 3 topic tags that describe the post, proven ones first, 4 in all (the 1 to 5 band that scored better, inside the working count of 3 to 5 and Instagram's cap of 5). Facebook: #examplebooking plus the first tag of the set, 2 in all (where the 1 to 5 band meets Facebook's working count of 0 to 2), before the link. Stories: none.

strategy.video_length: under 60 s: better (1.32, 26 posts); 60 to 119 s: worse (0.73, 20 posts); 120 s or more: too few to judge (0.8, 2 posts)

boost_candidates.first_line: 5 ways to fill a no-show slot fast

Reminders the day before beat reminders the hour before for no-shows

strategy.boost_note: Turn these into paid ads in the ads tools; this skill doesn't boost posts.

Fewer gaps, and no extra work at the front desk.
